clips.title: The story
paras: In Shadowglen, Conservator Ilthalaine gives young night elf druids the Verdant Sigil as a summons to begin training.

Young night elves in Shadowglen who feel the call of the wild receive the Verdant Sigil from Conservator Ilthalaine. A messenger brings it from Mardant Strongoak, the druid trainer, and it directs novices to climb into Aldrassil's boughs. The token invites them to leave basic chores behind and begin serious study of communion with nature spirits and the mysteries of the Emerald Dream.

Presenting the Verdant Sigil to Mardant Strongoak begins a young druid's lifelong craft. Novices are not yet ready to walk the sleeping trance of the Emerald Dream, but the token marks the start of their mentorship. Under Mardant's instruction, they learn to read the wilderness's whispers and practice early shapeshifting and healing arts in service of Teldrassil.
